test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.**

Nyra have/ been taking / dance classes / this year.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is** "Nyra have."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"Nyra have"** of the sentence.
 
• The error in the original sentence is the use of** "have"** instead of **"has."**
 
• **"Nyra" **is a singular third-person subject, and in the present perfect tense, we use** "has" **with singular subjects.
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 

Correct sentence: ***Nyra has**__ been taking dance classes this year.*
